facts.fact: Paratus Group says it invested a further N$600 million (US$33.7 million) in the last year in its new private mobile network in Namibia, one-third of it for a digital technology stack, on top of N$1.42 billion (US$79.8 million) invested in network infrastructure since 2018; the year is taken from the 2025-09-04 publication date.

systems.platform: LTE and 5G; Cerillion digital stack, Nokia mobile network
